edit.title: Edit profile
edit.emailLocked: The email can't be changed for now.
edit.phoneHint: Peruvian mobile. Leave it empty to remove it.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.notificationsSoon: Notifications will be turned on soon. You can choose now how you want to get them.

deletion.title: Delete my account
deletion.intro: Before confirming, review what will happen.

consequences.sessions: You'll be signed out on all your devices.
consequences.bookings: Your active bookings will be cancelled with the refund that applies. They won't come back even if you change your mind.
consequences.grace: Your account will stay pending for {{days}} days. If you don't cancel the deletion before {{date}}, your personal data will be erased. This can't be undone.
consequences.undo: Until that date you can change your mind: sign in and choose "Cancel deletion".
consequences.kept: By law we keep, without data that identifies you, your bookings, payments and the score of your reviews.
consequences.email: We'll send you a confirmation email and a reminder 3 days before.

deletion.blockedTitle: You can't delete your account yet

blockers.SOLE_OWNER: You are the only owner of "{{name}}". Transfer the ownership or delete the barbershop first.
blockers.STAFF_ROLE: Your account has a support or admin role. Ask for it to be removed first.

deletion.alreadyPending: You already asked to delete your account. It will be deleted on {{date}}.
deletion.doneTitle: You asked to delete your account
deletion.doneMessage: Your account will be deleted on {{date}}. We sent you an email. If you change your mind, sign in before that date and cancel the deletion.

photo.title: Profile photo
photo.denied: We need permission to use your photos. Turn it on in your phone settings.
photo.unavailable: To upload photos you need the latest version of the app.
photo.hint: Barbershops where you book can see it.

privacy: Your date of birth and gender are optional and barbershops never see them.
birthDateInvalid: Write the date as day/month/year, for example 23/04/1995.

password.title: Change password
password.done: Password changed. We signed you out on your other devices.
